'''''Vagabond''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ship was destroyed during the [[Battle of Cavamina Minor]] by a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The battle of [[Cavamina Minor]] was a trap set by [[Attuma Duum]] for his personal enjoyment and to increase war profits by prolonging the war. Both fleets eventually withdrew after suffering casualties.

==Behind the scenes==
''Vagabond'' appears in ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''. The scene in which the ''Vagabond'' is mentioned includes an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] and a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]], both of which are heavily damaged; the text does not specify which one is the ''Vagabond.''
